findings: The customer payment exists in the connected Athom account, while a platform-account read returns resource_missing.
paymentProviderRoute drops stripeConnectAccountId and stripeChargeMode, so ordinary refund creation and reconciliation lose the original direct-charge account.
A missing provider refund id is replaced with pending:return:<id>; the Stripe adapter tries refunds.retrieve on that internal placeholder.
Support conversation and ticket list poll every 5 seconds, do not deduplicate active requests or wait for Retry-After. HTTP 429 appears as a raw dashboard_http_429 in the UI.
requiredCorrections: Preserve and validate the original Stripe connected-account identity for refund creation and status reads.
Use provider-specific read-only reconciliation for missing refund ids, preserving ambiguous state and preventing duplicate financial POSTs.
Use a shared refresh scheduler with deduplication and Retry-After backoff; retain loaded conversation and show a friendly status.
Explicitly resolve the already-recorded pending request after provider/account identity has been verified; never infer completed from notification acceptance.
